title: Procyanidin B1 Promotes PSMC3-NRF2 Ubiquitination to Induce Ferroptosis in Glioblastoma.
authors: Gao, Wei; Li, Yuan; Lin, Xiang; Deng, Kun; Long, Xinmiao; Li, Danyang; Huang, Meng; Wang, Xiangyu; Xu, Yucong; She, Xiaoling; Wu, Minghua
one_liner_zh: 该文研究原花青素B1通过PSMC3-NRF2泛素化诱导胶质母细胞瘤铁死亡，核心为蛋白-小分子互作与肿瘤治疗，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: NRF2 signaling is a crucial antioxidant defense mechanism against ferroptosis in tumors, and targeting NRF2 is essential for tumor therapy. However, the effectiveness of NRF2 inhibitors remains unexplored. The active ingredients of traditional Chinese medicine serve as important sources of NRF2 inhibitors. In this study, we established an intracranial glioblastoma (GBM) orthotopic model and observed the effects of procyanidin B1 on tumor growth and ferroptosis. Using protein-small-molecule docking, z-stack assay of laser confocal imaging, surface plasmon resonance assay, immunoprecipitation, mass spectrometry, and western blotting, we detected the binding between procyanidin B1 and NRF2 and the effect of PSMC3 on the ubiquitin-dependent degradation of NRF2 in GBM cells. Our results showed that procyanidin B1 acted as a novel NRF2 inhibitor to suppress GBM cell proliferation and prolonged the survival of GBM-bearing mice; it also mediated the interaction between PSMC3 and NRF2 to promote ubiquitin-dependent protein degradation of NRF2, which induced ferroptosis in GBM cells. In addition, we found that procyanidin B1 enhanced H(2)O(2) accumulation by downregulating NRF2 during ferroptosis in GBM cells. The botanical agent procyanidin B1 induced ferroptosis and exerted anti-tumor effects through PSMC3-mediated ubiquitin-dependent degradation of NRF2 proteins, providing a potential drug candidate for adjuvant therapy in patients with GBM.
abstract_zh: NRF2信号是肿瘤中对抗铁死亡（ferroptosis）的关键抗氧化防御机制，靶向NRF2对于肿瘤治疗至关重要。然而，NRF2抑制剂的有效性仍未得到探索。中药活性成分是NRF2抑制剂的重要来源。在本研究中，我们建立了颅内胶质母细胞瘤（GBM）原位模型，并观察了原花青素B1对肿瘤生长和铁死亡的影响。通过蛋白质-小分子对接、激光共聚焦成像的z-stack分析、表面等离子体共振分析、免疫沉淀、质谱和蛋白质印迹法，我们检测了原花青素B1与NRF2之间的结合，以及PSMC3对GBM细胞中NRF2泛素依赖性降解的影响。我们的结果表明，原花青素B1作为一种新型NRF2抑制剂，抑制了GBM细胞增殖并延长了荷瘤GBM小鼠的生存期；它还介导了PSMC3与NRF2之间的相互作用，促进NRF2的泛素依赖性蛋白降解，从而诱导GBM细胞发生铁死亡。此外，我们发现原花青素B1在GBM细胞铁死亡过程中通过下调NRF2增强了H(2)O(2)的积累。植物来源的原花青素B1通过PSMC3介导的NRF2蛋白泛素依赖性降解诱导铁死亡并发挥抗肿瘤作用，为GBM患者的辅助治疗提供了潜在的候选药物。
